remarks: Spacious, Gracious & Full of Light! This open and airy corner condo is located in one of Stamford's premier luxury buildings, complete with 24-hour doorman service. The welcoming Entry Foyer flows into a sunlit Living Room, adjacent to a separate Dining Area and a 3-season Enclosed Porch - perfect for enjoying morning coffee with gorgeous sunrise views.  The updated Kitchen features sleek Quartz countertops, stainless steel appliances, and abundant cabinetry. The generously sized en-suite Primary Bedroom offers wall-to-wall carpeting, a large Walk-In Closet, and a Marble Bath. Two additional well-proportioned Bedrooms (also with wall-to-wall carpeting) share a second full Marble Bath. Convenience abounds with in-unit Laundry, a bonus Walk-In Hall Closet, and 2 reserved Garage Parking spaces. Residents enjoy access to resort-style amenities including a heated in-ground pool, grassy courtyard, two fitness centers, and a library. Recent building enhancements include a new facade, windows, walkways, refurbished hallways, upgraded landscaping, and an inviting front entrance. All this, ideally located in the heart of downtown - just moments from restaurants, shops, theaters, the train, and more!
